camel_example: aliyun linkcard UpdateAutoRechargeSwitch --region cn-hangzhou --Iccid '89860321******15668' --Open true --version 2021-05-20 --method POST --force
description_en: Enables or disables the auto-renewal feature for an IoT card. This operation applies only to single-card plans and same-tier pool plans
description_zh: 该接口用于开启或关闭卡的自动续费功能，仅适用于单卡套餐和同档位池套餐
name: UpdateAutoRechargeSwitch

parameters.help_en:
The Integrated Circuit Card Identifier (ICCID) of the IoT card.

You can view the ICCID on the IoT card or on the Card Management page in the IoT SIM Service console (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在物联网SIM服务控制台 (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)的卡管理页面查看ICCID
parameters.name: iccid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: Enables auto-renewal.

false: Disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费开关。

true：开启自动续费。

false：关闭自动续费
parameters.name: open
